decision: Disable automatic Git maintenance for the CI job so temporary repositories cannot spawn detached cleanup racers.
rationale: CI run 34018748260 confirms original fixtures pass; turns/close.test.ts then failed ENOTEMPTY in .git. The same test job creates many temporary repos from the growing ledger. Process-scoped Git configuration covers all Git subprocesses in both pnpm test and saved verification without altering global/user configuration or test assertions.

discovery.regression: Exercise episode/close fixtures on Node22 with exact CI overrides, then verify remote Linux CI.
